children: Greene County Bancorp approved a $0.11 quarterly cash dividend, maintaining an annualized rate of $0.44 per share.
Board declared $0.11 per share quarterly cash dividend, equal to prior quarter's rate and $0.44 annualized.
Dividend record date set for November 13, 2026, with expected payment on November 27, 2026.
Majority holder Greene County Bancorp, MHC (owns 54.1%) will waive its right to receive this dividend.
Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia granted nonobjection to MHC waivers aggregating up to $0.64 per share for four quarters through Dec 31, 2026.
